felony-base.json.command: PYTHONPATH=model python -m felony train model/runs/base --base model/base/felony-untrained.json --updates 2048 --seed 1

notes: Neither file contains a sampling key or salt. Scores use 1000 seat-swapped development games per opponent. Five heuristics are training opponents; cyclic is an extra public development opponent. These are sanity checks, not a strength rating. Training reproduced byte for byte twice in the recorded local CPU environment.
